layouts.rationale: Transport on top (prev/play/next), library toggles in row 2, finding music in row 3, navigation at the bottom; both volumes on the left dial, seek with now-playing art and the playlist browser on the right.
For spoken word, seeking matters more than skipping: seek keys flank play, prev/next drop to row 2; the right dial's second layer becomes playback speed.
Transport and like on top, modes and finding below; volume, seek (with art), the playlist browser and the Windows mixer on the four dials.
Same as player with seek keys first and the speed dial replacing the playlist browser.

conflicts: S1 lists 'Mute/Unmute: M' and Up/Down/Left/Right as Go to previous / Go to next / Add to Library / Add to Queue; the app's code (S2) binds all five only in the video watch feed (WF_*). The desktop app has no mute chord.

S4 (2022) and S6: Ctrl+Shift+Down mute, Ctrl+Shift+Up max volume, Ctrl+P preferences, Ctrl+Shift+W log out, F1 help. Current S1/S2: no mute/max keys, Ctrl+Comma preferences, Alt+Shift+F6 log out, Ctrl+/ (or ?) help.

Desktop vs web player (S5, and S2's own branches): web uses Alt+Up/Down volume, Alt+S shuffle, Alt+R repeat, Ctrl+Shift+L search, Alt+Shift+P new playlist; the Windows desktop app uses Ctrl+Up/Down, Ctrl+S, Ctrl+R, Ctrl+L, Ctrl+N.
S7 says Spotify for Windows has a Settings > Keyboard shortcuts toggle for global hotkeys; the app's strings (S3) have no such setting (only 'Show desktop overlay when using media keys').
S1's opener images are captioned Ctrl + Backslash while its table says Ctrl + /; the code (S2) binds mod+/ and ?.
gaps: Spotify's own volume, like/heart state and the playlist browser need Connect (user's own Client ID); player commands through the Web API also need Premium. Without Connect: transport, shuffle, repeat, seek and now playing still work (Windows media session) and the MIXER dial replaces volume.
Seek distance of Shift+Left/Right and the playback-speed step are not in the table (unknown).
Podcast sub-context detection needs PlayerSnapshot.ItemType surfaced to the engine (unverified).
Video watch-feed keys (Up/Down/Left/Right/M) omitted: no detector for the watch feed.
Store build not installed here: its AUMID and prefs path come from community sources.
Key-press seek and volume-step module verbs (spotify.seek, spotify.volume with delta) are marked planned: the service methods exist but no key action calls them.
notes: Excluded on purpose: Log out (Alt+Shift+F6), Select all (Ctrl+A), context menu (Alt+J), sidebar widths (Alt+Shift+arrows), debug window.

Also verified in S2 but not added: Ctrl+Shift+N new folder, Ctrl+F filter, Ctrl+Alt+F filter Your Library, Alt+Shift+5/6/7 audiobooks/authors/events, Alt+Shift+N new releases, Alt+Shift+C charts, Alt+Shift+Y recents, Alt+Shift+L left sidebar, Shift+C subtitles.
